newsitem.title: INDIA: India forex market inactive as Bombay banks closed.
newsitem.headline: India forex market inactive as Bombay banks closed.

text.p: India's foreign exchange market was inactive on Wednesday as banks in Bombay, the main commercial centre, were closed for a Hindu festival, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 35.81/82 against the dollar on Tuesday compared to an opening of 35.84/85, firming in reaction to a large dollar sale by an exporter and good inward remittances, dealers said.
Banks in Madras and Calcutta are open but there were hardly any transactions, dealers said.
